name: posha-api-mcp

tools.name: list_available_resources
tools.description: Lists all 17 available resource types with their filterable fields, operators, sort options, and approximate collection sizes. Use this first to understand what data is available before querying.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Get a single resource by its ID. Works for any of the 17 resource types: users, sessions, session-logs, recipes, recipe-revisions, recipe-classifications, recipe-categories, recipe-ingredient-classifications, machines, ingredients, ingredient-blocks, ingredient-normalizations, food-properties, cook-templates, dispense-templates, analytical-events.

id.description: The resource ID (ObjectId for most resources, Firebase UID for users, machineId for machines)

tools.name: query_resources
tools.description: Query any resource type with filters, sorting, pagination, and field projection. Supports nested AND/OR filter combinations. Resource types: users, sessions, session-logs, recipes, recipe-revisions, recipe-classifications, recipe-categories, recipe-ingredient-classifications, machines, ingredients, ingredient-blocks, ingredient-normalizations, food-properties, cook-templates, dispense-templates, analytical-events. Use list_available_resources to see available fields and operators for each type.

filters.description: Filter tree: either a leaf { field, op, value } or a group { operator: "and"|"or", conditions: [...] }. Max 3 levels deep.

projection.description: List of field names to include in the response (omit for all fields)

limit.description: Number of results per page (default 20, max 50)

tools.name: get_session_feedback
tools.description: Get the feedback data for a specific cooking session, including overall rating and specific feedback items.

tools.name: get_session_customisations
tools.description: Get the pre-cooking customisations for a specific session (food property adjustments like spice level, oil amount, etc.).

tools.name: get_session_metadata
tools.description: Get session metadata including timing information, step details, and execution stats.

tools.name: query_session_logs
tools.description: Query log entries for a specific session. Supports three log types: "logs" (all entries), "images" (IMAGE_LOG entries), "instructions" (RECIPE_UPDATE entries). Uses the same filter/sort/pagination as query_resources. Filterable fields: logT (timestamp), logC (category), logCtx (source), logS (severity), msg, tags.

logType.description: Type of logs: "logs" for all, "images" for IMAGE_LOG, "instructions" for RECIPE_UPDATE

tools.name: list_session_images
tools.description: List all images captured during a cooking session, sorted by capture time. Returns image summaries with filename, capture time, instruction ID, and image type.

tools.name: get_session_instruction_images
tools.description: Get images for a specific cooking instruction within a session. Optionally include only pre/post dispense images.

prePostDispenseOnly.description: If true, returns only pre-dispense and post-dispense images for the instruction

tools.name: get_session_image_detail
tools.description: Get full metadata for a specific image including camera details, tangible/intangible details, and image client context.

imageId.description: The image filename (with or without extension)

tools.name: get_session_macro_images
tools.description: List images with macro/liquid ingredient state details at capture time. Shows what ingredients (with quantities) were in the pan when each image was taken. Optionally filter by stirrer state.

isStirrerOn.description: Filter images by stirrer state (true = stirrer on, false = stirrer off, omit for all)

tools.name: download_session_image
tools.description: Download a session image from S3. Saves to local disk and/or renders inline in chat. Use 'source' to control which S3 folder: 'auto' (waterfall: normal → high-res, default), 'high-res' (metadata/high_res_images/ only). Use 'mode' to control output: 'both' (save + render, default), 'download' (save only), 'render' (inline only).

imageId.description: The image filename (with or without extension, e.g. 'GeneratedImage_0' or '40.jpeg')

source.description: S3 source: 'auto' waterfalls normal → high-res (default), 'high-res' targets metadata/high_res_images/ only

mode.description: Output mode: 'both' saves to disk + renders inline (default), 'download' saves only, 'render' renders inline only

tools.name: list_high_res_images
tools.description: List all high-resolution image filenames available for a session. These are stored in S3 under metadata/high_res_images/ and are typically higher quality than the standard inference images.

tools.name: batch_download_images
tools.description: Download multiple images to disk for one or more sessions. Use 'filter' to control which images: 'all' (every image in session), 'instruction' (images from a specific instruction ID), 'high-res' (only high-res images from S3). Optionally filter by instructionType (e.g. 'Cook', 'Dispense'). Downloads save to ~/Downloads/posha-images/{sessionId}/. Set previewCount (1-3) to render a few sample images inline. Cap: 500 images total across all sessions.

sessionIds.description: One or more session ObjectIds (24-char hex strings)

filter.description: Which images to download: 'all' (default), 'instruction' (needs instructionId), 'high-res' (S3 high-res only)

instructionId.description: Instruction ID to filter by (required when filter='instruction')

instructionType.description: Filter by instruction type (e.g. 'Cook', 'Dispense'). Only applies when filter='all'

limit.description: Max images to download per session (default: all, max: 500)

previewCount.description: Render first N images inline as preview (0-3, default: 0)

tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Search images across all sessions within a time range. Requires at least a time range. Supports filtering by session IDs, instruction types (Cook, Dispense), container types (Macro, Liquid, Micro), machine ID, recipe ID, user ID, ingredient IDs, image tags, and more. Time limits: 30 days default, 90 days with narrowing filters.

startTime.description: Start time in ISO8601 format (e.g. 2026-03-29T00:00:00Z). Either startTime or startTimeEpoch required.

startTimeEpoch.description: Start time in epoch milliseconds (alternative to startTime)

endTimeEpoch.description: End time in epoch milliseconds (alternative to endTime)

ingredientIds.description: Filter by ingredient IDs present in the image

tools.name: get_machine_storage
tools.description: Get the on-device storage reflection (snapshot) for a specific machine, including installed recipes and ingredient data.

tools.name: get_machine_details
tools.description: Get additional details for a machine: users registered on the machine, and/or crash dump files from S3. Use the "include" parameter to choose what to fetch.

include.description: What to include: "users" for registered users, "crash-dumps" for crash dump files, "both" for everything
